spans.s:
n. (-ख्यं)
Ugliness of the nails.
E.
कुनख, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-कं)
Neglect of personal decoration.
E.
कु bad, नखी a nail, आदि etcetera, कन् added, and अण् affix; allowing the nails to grow, &c.

m. (-कः)
A spearman, a soldier armed with a spear.
E.
कुन्त a spear, affix ठक्.

f. (-न्ती)
A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
E.
कुन्ति here said to mean a country, affixes अण् and ङीष्; produced in that district.

m. (-यः)
Either of the Pāṇḍu princes.
E.
कुन्ती, and ढक् affix, son of KUNTĪ.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दी-न्दं)
Relating to the jasmine.
E.
कुन्द, and अण् aff.
